methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic information units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. The decomposition focused on extracting the core functional aspects of the JK flip-flop and its truth table behavior. For the generated specification, both the combinational logic and the timing logic summaries were considered to capture all relevant atomic units.
mindtraced_atomic_units: The flip-flop is a JK type.
The flip-flop has a clock input.
The flip-flop has inputs J and K.
The flip-flop has an output Q.
When J=0 and K=0, Q(t+1) = Q(t).
Q changes on the positive edge of the clock.
spec_atomic_units: The module has inputs clk, j, and k.
The module has an output Q.
The output Q changes its value only on the positive edge of the clock signal clk.
The next value of Q depends on the current values of j, k, and the current value of Q (previous state).
When j=0 and k=0, Q retains its previous value.
When j=0 and k=1, Q becomes 0.
When j=1 and k=0, Q becomes 1.
When j=1 and k=1, Q toggles its value.
